g_b_sourced_result.estimator_selection_concern: the outcome depends on choosing the forward-consistent payout basis. The other two admissible SPX bases fail outright — Damodaran year-end 0.6386 gives 3.23% and trailing-P/E 0.5676 gives 8.84%, both above the 2.5% gate. km's reason is principled, that a forward-consensus-ROE model wants a forward payout basis, and the handler accepts the reasoning. It is recorded because the reason was surfaced together with the result rather than before it.

g_c_global_result.verdict: CANNOT CLEAR — the b-set it was run on is inadmissible

metric_correction.issue: km reported rms expressed as a percentage of the index level; the frozen gate is MAXIMUM ABSOLUTE CELL ERROR
metric_correction.reading: a single global c CAN satisfy the max-cell gate at c about 0.099, so the fit itself is real. What blocks the clearance is the provenance of b, not the arithmetic.

g_c_global_result.economic_plausibility_flag: c about 0.099 implies a discount rate of Rf + 9.9% = 13.4% while the residual-income hurdle is Rf + RP = 8.5% to 10.0%. The model would discount at roughly 4pp above the return it requires, with nothing in any source explaining why. This is not a gate and does not decide anything, but it is recorded as a reason the parameterisation should not be trusted on fit quality alone.

b0_status: UNCHANGED — B0_CANDIDATE_FOUND. km self-classified correctly. The printed PBR table remains 2018-10-12 against grids dated 2018-10-11.

new_counter_evidence_against_the_pbr_as_.finding: the QQQ ETF grid is not consistent with the index model plus its own printed PBR of 4.9 — the implied required return is about 4.4% against a printed Rf+RP of about 8.5%
new_counter_evidence_against_the_pbr_as_.significance: if the same report's printed PBR were the model's book basis, its own ETF grid should not contradict it. This weakens the PBR-as-B0 hypothesis from inside the source.

what_the_discriminator_established: one index of three now has an admissibly sourced retention, and a single global c can satisfy the max-cell gate. That is real progress and it is why the family is not refuted. It is not an identification: two of three retentions are inadmissible on date or provenance, the book basis remains inadmissible, the horizon rests on that book basis, and the implied discount is economically unexplained.
what_would_still_settle_it: an S&P DJI DJIA factsheet with an as-of at or before 2018-10-11
a NASDAQ-100 payout or retention at or before 2018-10-11
any 2018 Kiwoom report printing a book basis at or before its own grid data date
any source explaining a discount rate roughly 4pp above the stated cost of capital
